parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The operation that you want to perform. Set the value to **GetAcl**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga get-acl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id nacl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000 --region cn-hangzhou
